services.name: Snook Fishing
services.desc: The snook is a prized fish amongst anglers in the St. Pete Beach / Tampa Bay area. A snook can be identified by its underslung lower jaw, large fins, distinctive body shape, tapered head and snout, and most easily identifiable factor, a black stripe running across the full length of the fish’s lateral line. Snook season in FL is closed from Dec. 1st through the end of February and May 1st through August 31st. If you already know that snook are in season, you may be heading out for a fishing trip on St. Pete Beach and wondering what to expect. services.desc: At St. Pete Beach Charters, our Captains have over 10 years of experience navigating the waters of Tampa Bay, St. Pete Beach, Gulfport, Clearwater, Treasure Island, Madeira Beach, and the surrounding areas. As the official Sunset Cruise of St. Pete Beach LLC, we specialize in creating an evening that you and your group are sure to remember for years to come. When you book a private Sunset Cruise, we will spend our time navigating and exploring the intracoastal waterways of the Tampa Bay area while we make our way to one of the greatest sunsets you will ever see.
